overview.title: Whole Zer0 graph
overview.caption: Semantic zoom compresses the world into logic first, then reveals concepts, important detail and source evidence as you move closer.

slides.title: Zer0
slides.caption: A federation of independently useful repos joined by contracts, measurement, routing, execution and verified learning. z0 is the canonical map; z0archy is this visual projection.

nodes.title: Zer0
nodes.tip: Source of truth for component boundaries, profiles and cross-system interfaces. z0archy renders it; it does not replace it.

slides.title: Interaction + runtime
slides.caption: Where users and agents actually act. OMP owns execution; learned policy does not bypass runtime authority.

nodes.title: OMP (Oh My Pi)
nodes.tip:
Coding agent runtime: CLI, RPC, RLM context spill, Jev decisions, Handsfree HUD, Live voice, and computer-use stage manager.
